narration: In month {fork_month}, your mother wanted a share of your savings put away and called it security, with a wedding nobody named behind it. You chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. From then on the ghost's net worth stayed above yours, {ghost_ahead_months} months without a break. The layoff in month {layoff_month} found the ghost with {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. On Life, which by then read both of you as mostly getting by, the ghost was {life_gap}.
